definitions.explanation: Organized learning or skill development, typically in a professional or educational context.

examples.japanese: {新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}{研修|けんしゅう}に{参加|さんか}する。
examples.english: To participate in new employee training.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}で{研修|けんしゅう}を{受|う}ける。
{研修|けんしゅう}{期間|きかん}は3{ヶ月|かげつ}だ。
examples.english: The training period is three months.

notes:
{研修|けんしゅう} refers to organized professional training or development. Composed of {研|けん} (polish/study) + {修|しゅう} (learn/master).

COMMON TYPES:
- {新人|しんじん}{研修|けんしゅう}: new employee training
- {社内|しゃない}{研修|けんしゅう}: in-house training
- {海外|かいがい}{研修|けんしゅう}: overseas training
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}{研修|けんしゅう}: technical training

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {研修|けんしゅう}を{受|う}ける: to receive training
- {研修|けんしゅう}に{参加|さんか}する: to participate in training
- {研修|けんしゅう}{期間|きかん}: training period

RELATED TERMS:
- {研修生|けんしゅうせい}: trainee
- {研修|けんしゅう}{制度|せいど}: training program/system
- {練習|れんしゅう}: practice (more hands-on, skill-based)
